result.instructions: Tools for NPPES NPI Registry, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes NPPES NPI Registry data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run nppes_npi_registry_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nppes_npi_registry_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nppes_npi_registry_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. nppes_npi_registry_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nppes_lookup_npi
tools.title: Look up a provider by NPI number
tools.description: Look up a single healthcare provider by their exact 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI). Returns the full registry record: basic info, addresses, taxonomies/specialties, identifiers and other names. NPPES Read API v2.1.

number.description: The 10-digit NPI number to look up, e.g. '1467550004' (required).

annotations.title: Look up a provider by NPI number

tools.name: nppes_search_individuals
tools.title: Search individual providers
tools.description: Search for INDIVIDUAL healthcare providers (NPI-1: doctors, nurses, therapists, etc.) by name, specialty (taxonomy) and/or location. Provide at least one meaningful criterion beyond a location. Name fields support a trailing '*' wildcard (min 2 chars before it). NPPES Read API v2.1.

first_name.description: Provider first name. A trailing '*' wildcard is allowed, e.g. 'Jo*'.

last_name.description: Provider last name. A trailing '*' wildcard is allowed, e.g. 'Smi*'.

name_purpose.description: Which name to match: 'PROVIDER' (default) matches the provider's own name; 'AO' matches an authorized official.

taxonomy_description.description: Provider taxonomy / specialty text, e.g. 'cardiology', 'Pediatrics', 'Social Worker'. Partial matches supported; a trailing '*' wildcard is allowed (min 2 chars before it).

postal_code.description: Postal (ZIP) code; a trailing '*' wildcard is allowed for prefix search, e.g. '941*'.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code (default 'US'). Use 'US' for domestic addresses.

address_purpose.description: Which address the city/state/postal_code filters apply to (LOCATION = practice address).

limit.description: Max number of records to return (1–200, default 10).

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (0–1000; combined with limit, up to 1200 records reachable).

tools.name: nppes_search_organizations
tools.title: Search organization providers
tools.description: Search for ORGANIZATION healthcare providers (NPI-2: hospitals, clinics, group practices, pharmacies, labs, etc.) by organization name, specialty (taxonomy) and/or location. The organization_name field supports a trailing '*' wildcard (min 2 chars before it). NPPES Read API v2.1.

organization_name.description: Organization (legal business) name. A trailing '*' wildcard is allowed, e.g. 'Kaiser*'.

taxonomy_description.description: Provider taxonomy / specialty text, e.g. 'cardiology', 'Pediatrics', 'Social Worker'. Partial matches supported; a trailing '*' wildcard is allowed (min 2 chars before it).

postal_code.description: Postal (ZIP) code; a trailing '*' wildcard is allowed for prefix search, e.g. '941*'.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code (default 'US'). Use 'US' for domestic addresses.

address_purpose.description: Which address the city/state/postal_code filters apply to (LOCATION = practice address).

limit.description: Max number of records to return (1–200, default 10).

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (0–1000; combined with limit, up to 1200 records reachable).

tools.name: nppes_search
tools.title: Search the NPI registry (all criteria)
tools.description: Full-power search of the NPPES NPI Registry across ANY combination of criteria — individual name, organization name, NPI number, taxonomy/specialty, and location. Use nppes_search_individuals / nppes_search_organizations for the common cases; use this when you need mixed or advanced criteria. The API requires at least one meaningful search parameter. NPPES Read API v2.1.

enumeration_type.description: Restrict to 'NPI-1' (individuals) or 'NPI-2' (organizations). Omit to search both.

first_name.description: Individual provider first name (trailing '*' wildcard allowed).

last_name.description: Individual provider last name (trailing '*' wildcard allowed).
